versions.changelog:
- Initial release.
- Enables public data export from Douyin, including keyword search, author posts, video comments, and real-time hot trends via CLI commands.
- Automatically interprets varied user queries to trigger the relevant mode (search, post, comment, hot).
- Structured JSON output, comprehensive command options, and strict token validation for security.
- Full workflow support for content research, competition analysis, and trending topic insight.
